takeaway: The T10 opening (oesophageal hiatus, in the right crus) transmits the oesophagus, the left gastric artery and vein and the two vagi.

lines.text: Which structure passes through the diaphragm opening at the level of T10?
lines.say: Which structure passes through the diaphragm opening at the level of T ten?

lines.text: This is the oesophageal opening, between the muscular fibres of the right crus.
the left gastric artery and vein,
So at T10, the answer is the left gastric artery.
lines.say: So at T ten, the answer is the left gastric artery.

lines.text: The inferior vena cava and right phrenic nerve pass higher, at T8; the azygous vein and thoracic duct go with the aorta at T12.
lines.say: (clears throat) The inferior vena cava and right phrenic nerve pass higher, at T eight; the azygous vein and thoracic duct go with the aorta at T twelve.
